prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent PIXEL-ART MAP SPRITE sheet for a 4x tactical RPG. Image1 is the EXACT map pose/phase/order guide, Image2 is the same young BLUE-HAIRED male hero's new Dawn Warrior outfit identity, Image3 is his new sword object design. The same recognisable youthful male in every cell: short side-swept solid muted blue hair, tan face, pale ice-blue shoulder/chest/knee armor, deep navy tunic, gauntlets, short split tassets and boots, silver fasteners, short navy shoulder mantle securely attached and ending at waist. No brown costume and no gold overload. Adapt Image2 to Image1's squat readable MAP proportions with a large head and compact limbs, not tall battle anatomy. Match the native pose and physical part meaning, especially which foot/knee and forearm is in front. Hair ONE flat #205b96, no hair or clothing highlights, matte large pixel clusters and necessary navy outlines/shadows. Palette only #172638 #263c64 #3976a8 #a7d7e5 #e4e5df #d7a27c #a6776a #205b96 #b9c5d1 #4366b9. Within each direction pair the head, neck, torso center, waist and hip are EXACTLY stationary at the same coordinates, identical body size; only feet/legs and the appropriate arms articulate. No whole-figure x/y sway, bob, scale pulses, detached hands or missing feet. Two real arms and two legs, complete sprites and clear transparent gutters, no labels, frames, text, cast shadows, ground or glow. Genuine transparent background. EXACTLY 3 columns x 2 rows = SIX figures. Order: row1 front phase0, back phase0, RIGHT-facing phase0; row2 front phase1, back phase1, RIGHT-facing phase1. Copy source direction and each corresponding leg/foot/arm gesture exactly. Front0 left knee comes forward, right leg supports; front1 right knee forward, left leg supports. Back0 and back1 likewise alternate opposite feet, shoulders remain fixed, cloak does not cover lower legs/feet. Right0 compact passing stride with arm bent forward, right1 wider stride with forward/rear legs swapped and rear arm behind the body. Same silhouette/head coordinates within each top/bottom pair. Story traveling scene: sword sheathed at hip, navy scabbard with silver edge; recognisable small circular BLUE gem guard and short blue feather visible at the hilt as Image3, no sword held in hand, no bow or shield held. Hands are free for natural walking. Back view shows blue hair back and waist-length navy mantle, no visible face. Keep upper-body armor design identical between front/side/back.
